title: Chess, But Anish Giri GRABS Pieces Off the Board
summary: Chess vs Fairy-Stockfish with a one-time 'Anish Giri' power-up (cartoon Anish with a long grabbing arm beside the board). Once per game the player can click Anish, who removes one random enemy piece (never the king) from the board permanently. Narrator trades pawns and minor pieces to raise the odds of the steal hitting a queen or rook, uses it, and wins with a ladder mate in a rook endgame.
rules: Standard chess start; player White vs Fairy-Stockfish (UI 'Stockfish (3600)').
Once per game the player may activate Anish (click his avatar): a uniformly random enemy non-king piece is removed permanently.
Activating Anish costs no move / is instant [inferred; clicked between moves].
